card.name: Inside names and rare words
card.fires_on: Short endings or middle pieces inside a split-up proper name or rare word, such as the 'ia' in Portia, 'ria' in nutria, 'IP' in NIPENT, or 'es' in Torsade de Pointes.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: Middle or end piece of an uppercase drug brand name split into parts.
modes.example: No specific antidote for N<<IP>>ENT overdose is known.

modes.label: Medical term ending
modes.description: Final piece of the term Torsade de Pointes.

card.writes: No clear output effect, though it leans toward odd multilingual pieces, so it likely marks a word as still unfinished.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unusual name that gets split into pieces, like a drug brand or a rare animal name.
